module_import: from atm import CardlessATMSimulator, TrustedWalletContext, ATMActor, PUBLIC_ATM_FIXTURES
runtime_dependency: Existing blackberryrock.wallet.Wallet and Python standard library; same Wallet database, no separate ledger.

storage.parent: daemon-owned directory with no group/other permissions (0700)
storage.database: owned regular SQLite file, tightened to 0600; existing WAL/SHM tightened too
storage.transaction: Existing Wallet._transaction BEGIN IMMEDIATE with credential, journal, withdrawal and receipt in one commit
storage.raw_code: Only private atm.issue wallet_idempotency result_json; naturally may persist in WAL/backups

trusted_owner_boundary.source: Authenticated protected membership only, passed outside request JSON
trusted_owner_boundary.guard: Hold membership admission guard across eligibility resolution and issue; same owner/device may resolve existing holds after expiry/cancellation
trusted_owner_boundary.binding: First successful issue permanently binds current simulator Wallet to owner/device; transfer is not implemented
trusted_owner_boundary.snapshot: Use the existing shared adapter snapshot guard across Wallet, membership and ATM reads, and serialize mutations with the same guard.

trusted_atm_boundary.source: Separate test-only ATM actor path, never owner request JSON
trusted_atm_boundary.fixtures: PUBLIC_ATM_FIXTURES contains intentionally public tokens for SIM-ATM-001 and SIM-ATM-002

dispatch.errors: ATMError / AuthenticationError subclass WalletError; existing InsufficientFunds and IdempotencyConflict; SQLite / OSError propagate.

receipt_contract.issue: Immutable historical issuance receipt; code must never be logged; state_at_issue is not current state.
receipt_contract.redeem: Same authorization_id on same-key replay; repeated authorization receipt is not a second dispense instruction.
receipt_contract.current_state: Call status or history; these contain code_sha256 only.
receipt_contract.io_error: An error may follow a successful commit. Keep the original key and payload; retry or inspect status, never assume failure means rollback.
receipt_contract.cash_assertion: Both dispense and reconcile amounts are cumulative. Source is PUBLIC_ATM_FIXTURE_ASSERTION, not physical dispenser proof.

cleanup.caller_action: Schedule expire_due with a fresh key for each new pass; retain that key when retrying the same pass.
cleanup.expired_unconsumed: Redemption blocked at deadline; cleanup/redeem/cancel/expire atomically releases hold.
cleanup.consumed_timeout_cancel_expiry: UNKNOWN; retain remaining hold until separately authenticated final cumulative assertion.
cleanup.close: No close method needed; no persistent connections or threads.

integration_limits: Existing ordinary Wallet reserve / dispense / mark_unknown / reconcile authentication is unchanged and must not be exposed as bypasses.
Wallet / credential divergence is detected but does not secure separate legacy endpoints.
No real ATM transport, physical cash dispenser, provider, real funds, KYC validation, secure clock, hardware antirollback, production secret management or device transfer.
Host focused tests only; target guest acceptance is NOT_RUN.
